office_does: A Yakima County District Court judge hears misdemeanor and gross-misdemeanor criminal cases, traffic infractions, civil cases up to $100,000, small claims and protection orders; the four judges are elected countywide.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Judge Alfred G. Schweppe is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Yakima County District Court judge since 2013 and its presiding judge; former deputy prosecutor and civil attorney; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: District Court judge since 2013 and presiding judge [S1][S2]
Presides over DUI Court for repeat DUI offenders [S1]
Deputy prosecutor 1995-2001, then partner in a Yakima law firm 2002-2012 [S1]
